import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the docx content
doc = Document("docs/customer_report.docx")
paragraphs = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    paragraphs.append((para.text, para.style.name))

# Create PDF using PyMuPDF
pdf = fitz.open()

page = pdf.new_page(width=595, height=842)  # A4 size
y = 72  # top margin

for text, style in paragraphs:
    if not text.strip():
        y += 12
        continue
    if "Heading" in style:
        fontsize = 18
        fontname = "helv"
    else:
        fontsize = 11
        fontname = "helv"

    text_point = fitz.Point(72, y)
    page.insert_text(text_point, text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
    y += fontsize + 6

pdf.save("docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully at docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''

import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = "agent@workspace.local"
msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Report"

body = "Hi Bob,\\n\\nPlease find the customer report attached as a PDF.\\n\\nBest regards"
msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

with open("docs/customer_report.pdf", "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

# Try sending via localhost SMTP
try:
    server = smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25, timeout=5)
    server.sendmail(msg["From"], [msg["To"]], msg.as_string())
    server.quit()
    print("Email sent successfully via localhost SMTP")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"SMTP send attempt: {e}")
    # Save the email as .eml file as fallback
    with open("docs/customer_report_email.eml", "w") as ef:
        ef.write(msg.as_string())
    print("Email saved as docs/customer_report_email.eml (no SMTP server available)")
'''
